details: Geopolitical tensions have intensified after President Trump reportedly rejected Iran's proposal for a seven-day ceasefire and reopening of the Strait of Hormuz. He also declined to rule out renewed military strikes before the November midterm elections. This escalation has led to a rise in crude oil prices and US Treasury yields, contributing to a risk-off sentiment in global financial markets, negatively impacting Bitcoin and other cryptocurrencies.
title: US-Iran Tensions Escalate Over Strait of Hormuz, Pressuring Crypto

details: The cryptocurrency market is preparing for increased volatility this week as several crucial US economic data reports are scheduled for release. These include the August JOLTS job openings, August PCE inflation data (the Federal Reserve's preferred inflation gauge), and the third estimate of Q2 GDP. Strong economic indicators could reinforce expectations for additional Federal Reserve interest rate hikes, which typically create headwinds for risk assets like Bitcoin and altcoins by reducing liquidity and increasing the appeal of safer investments.
title: Crypto Market Braces for Volatile Week Amid Key US Economic Data
